{{Top|leg}}
A '''locking activator''' (alternatively called '''blade lock''') was a specialized [[activation stud]] located on the [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] that could lock the weapon's blade into the activated position, even when the wielder was not holding the lightsaber. It was also used by wielders who frequently used their lightsabers as a [[Telekinesis/Legends#Saber Throw|thrown]] weapon.<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref> The locking of the blade prevented it from being accidentally deactivated when the weapon impacted the target.

The locking activator was utilized by [[Jax Pavan]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|18.8 BBY]] during his [[Battle in the Factory District|encounter]] with [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]]. [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing's]] [[Aurra Sing's lightsaber|lightsaber]] also had this device. In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Leia Organa Solo]] used a locking function to swing [[Leia's lightsaber/Legends|her lightsaber]]'s blade like a pendulum into a pursuing [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]], after attaching the [[Hilt/Legends|hilt]] to a [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|tree]] branch by [[Rope/Legends|rope]].<ref name="HTTE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>
